top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation turns a biological process into a defined chemical reaction: a small molecule becomes an adaptor that induces a ternary complex so the cell's own E3 ligase ubiquitinates and removes a chosen protein. The mechanism is supported by structures, degradation kinetics and independent reproduction in many laboratories, and thalidomide-class glues are already in clinical use. Crews and Deshaies conceived the rationally designed bifunctional strand and Handa identified cereblon, which explains the glue strand, so the three-name allocation with a citation naming both PROTACs and molecular glues is defensible, though Ciulli, Sakamoto and Kim have credible claims and no PROTAC drug is yet approved. P002 is the more mature and cleanly attributed chemistry and second; P003 is third because of the chemistry-versus-platform question and entangled credit; no award is last.
